programs.title: Strange Evidence
programs.desc: A gravity-defying cube spins through the skies over Missouri, raising questions about what propulsion system could power the mysterious aircraft; experts investigate footage released by the Pentagon that confirms the existence of these ominous objects.

programs.title: Strange Evidence
programs.desc: A truck engulfed in flames barrels down a lonely Brazilian highway, which could be the result of a sudden forest fire; experts investigate the story of a driver who somehow maneuvers his blazing cargo to a safe location.

programs.title: Strange Evidence
